mapper.insert: insert into gp_file_transfer ( share_code, original_name, stored_name, stored_path, file_size, content_type, password_hash, has_password, max_downloads, download_count, burn_after_read, expire_at, client_ip, fingerprint, machine_id, status, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{shareCode}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{storedPath}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{passwordHash}, #{hasPassword}, #{maxDownloads}, #{downloadCount}, #{burnAfterRead}, #{expireAt}, #{clientIp}, #{fingerprint}, #{machineId}, #{status}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select * from gp_file_transfer where share_code = #{shareCode} limit 1
mapper.update: update gp_file_transfer set status = 0, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from gp_file_transfer where id = #{id} limit 1
select * from gp_file_transfer where status = 0 and stored_path is not null and stored_path <> '' order by update_time asc limit #{limit}
